title Elementis Zeta - the title theme: a rising fanfare on a shimmering dominant, then a heroic tune (D minor) that lifts into F major (16 bars, loops)
tempo 124
vol 195
meter 4/4
inst lead v=255,255,215,185,170
inst hero att=2 vib=1 vdelay=8 vper=16 slow
inst maj arp=0,4,7 rate=2
inst min arp=0,3,7 rate=2
inst kick drum=g5 v=255,200,140 d=0,-45,-75
l4
# --- the fanfare (once): D F A D' in a flash, a long call, the dominant shimmers
@lead o5 d16 f16 a16 o6 d16 f4. e8 d4 |
@maj o5 a1 |
@loop
# --- the theme: three notes up and a leap (Dm Bb F A)
o5 d8 f8 a4 o6 d4. c8 |
o5 b-4 a8 g8 f4 a4 |
o6 c8 c8 f4 e8 d8 c4 |
o6 e4 c+4 @hero o5 a2 @lead |
# --- again, and it climbs to the cadence
o5 d8 f8 a4 o6 d4. c8 |
o5 b-4 o6 d4 f4 d4 |
o6 g4 f4 e4 d4 |
@min o5 d2 r2 @lead |
# --- it lifts into F major (F Bb C A), the kick enters
o5 !kick:f8 a8 o6 c4 f4 e8 d8 |
!kick:d4. c8 o5 b-4 f4 |
!kick:e8 g8 o6 c4 e4 d8 c8 |
!kick:e4 c+4 o5 a4 e4 |
# --- the same, rising to the high A and home (Dm Bb C A)
o6 !kick:d2 o5 a4 f4 |
!kick:b-4 o6 d4 f4 a4 |
!kick:g4 e4 c4 e4 |
@hero o6 c+4 e4 a2 |
